dotShapes.description: The look of the page dots. `dot` draws every page as a small round dot and marks the current one by colour alone, as UIPageControl does; `pill` stretches the current dot into a pill.

dotTones.description: The colours of the page dots. `neutral` marks the current dot in the primary text colour, `accent` in the primary action colour, and `on-media` draws white dots for a carousel of photos or video.

crossRenderer.intent: Show which slide of a paged carousel is current, and go to a slide by choosing its dot.

react: One button per snap point, named "Slide 2 of 5"; the current one carries aria-current.
`shape` and `tone` on CarouselDots pick round dots or a pill, and neutral, accent or on-media colours.
swiftUI: TabView with .page(indexDisplayMode: .never) pages the slides; AtomPageDots binds to its selection.
VoiceOver reads the dots as one adjustable element; swiping up or down changes the slide.
`shape:` and `tone:` on AtomPageDots take the same values; the round dots sit closer together, as UIPageControl does, because VoiceOver adjusts the indicator as one element.
